output.population: Young adult twins and siblings aged 18-30, plus adolescent twins scanned at 12 or 16 years, some rescanned four years later
output.summary: Multimodal neuroimaging of young adult twins and siblings, with a test-retest subsample and adolescent twins scanned at 12 or 16 years. Includes demographics, limited phenotypic data, and FreeSurfer-derived cortical and subcortical measures.
